Goal: measure local-9b Q5 at 128k. Done.

Findings (session/transcript.md):
- Baseline 37.8 t/s, VRAM 7881 MiB. 7881 is the WDDM ceiling; Shared Usage showed 1494 MiB spilled — invalid.

- Q6_K (7.03 GiB) does not fit at 128k; discarded. Q4_K_M fits (7305 MiB, 40.4 t/s) — fallback only.
- Recipe applied at scripts/start_server.ps1:165 (local9 block) and profiles/local/local-9b.json.
